outline:
透過簡短的寫作作業和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語寫作技巧和作文策略。  重點在於寫作與學術論證之間的關係，我們將在本學期學生開始研究和撰寫畢業論文時運用這些技能

Through short writing assignments and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English writing skills and strategies for composition.  Focusing on the relation between writing and academic arguments, we will apply those skills this semester as students begin the research and writing of their senior projects
schedule:
Week1: Intro

2-4:Senior Project proposals

5-6: Research I: field of study questions

7-8:Research II: primary texts

9:Midterm

10-12: Grammar review

13-14:Research III: secondary texts

15-17:Exercises in Style

18:Finals week
assessment:
Grades:
Midterm  50%
Final 50%

Weekly writing assignments:  each missing/late paper  =  -10 points from course grade

Plagiarized papers/videos, papers/videos previously submitted to other classes, and/or AI-generated papers/videos will receive a failing grade.

Attendance:
a combination of 2 absences or late days or classwork zeroes =  -10 points from course grade
a combination of 3 absences or late days or classwork zeroes =  -20 points from course grade
a combination of 4 absences or late days or classwork zeroes =  failing course grade
